word_for_word: प्रश्नाभिप्रायं विवृणोति कच्चिदिति
he explains the intention of the question with ‘does he perhaps?’
कर्मणामीश्वरार्पितत्वादननुष्ठानाच्च न तावत्कर्मफलं स्वर्गादिकं प्राप्नोति
because actions were offered to the Lord and not performed for fruit, he does not attain fruits of action such as heaven
योगानिष्पत्तेश्च न मोक्षं प्राप्नोति
and because yoga was not perfected, he does not attain liberation
एवमुभयस्माद्भ्रष्टोऽप्रतिष्ठो निराश्रयः
thus fallen from both, without foundation and support
अतएव ब्रह्मणः प्राप्त्युपाये पथि मार्गे विमूढः सन् कच्चित्किं न नश्यति किंवा नश्यतीत्यर्थः
and confused on the path that is the means to attaining Brahman, does he not perish, or does he perish? this is the meaning
नाशे दृष्टान्तः यथा छिन्नमभ्रं पूर्वस्मादभ्राद्विश्लिष्टमभ्रान्तरं चाप्राप्तं सन्मध्य एव विलीयते तद्वत्
the example of destruction: as a severed cloud, detached from its former cloud and not reaching another, dissolves in between, so would he
त्वयैव सर्वज्ञेनायं मम संदेहो निरसनीयः
this doubt of mine must be removed by You alone, the omniscient
त्वत्तोऽन्यस्त्वेतत्संदेहनिवर्तको नास्तीत्याह एतन्म इति
there is no one other than You who can remove this doubt; he says ‘this doubt of mine’
एतत् एनम् छेत्ता निवर्तकः स्पष्टमन्यत्
‘etat’ means this; ‘cutter’ means remover; the rest is clear
अत्रोत्तरं श्रीभगवानुवाच पार्थेति सार्धैश्चतुर्भिः
in answer the Blessed Lord speaks in four and a half verses beginning ‘O Pārtha’
इह लोके नाश उभयभ्रंशात्पातित्यम्
destruction in this world means degradation through falling from both paths
अमुत्र परलोके नाशो नरकप्राप्तिः
destruction in the next world means attainment of hell
तदुभयं तस्य नास्त्येव
neither of these occurs for him
यतः कल्याणकृच्छुभकारी कश्चिदपि दुर्गतिं न गच्छति
because no doer of good ever goes to a bad state
अयं च शुभकारी श्रद्धया योगे प्रवृत्तत्वात्
and he is a doer of good because he entered yoga with faith
तातेति लोकरीत्योपलालयन्संबोधयति
‘dear one’ is an affectionate address according to ordinary usage
तर्हि किमसौ प्राप्नोतीत्यपेक्षायामाह प्राप्येति
then what does he attain? he says ‘having attained’
पुण्यकारिणामश्वमेधादियाजिनां लोकान्प्राप्य
having attained the worlds of meritorious persons who perform sacrifices such as Aśvamedha
तत्र शाश्वतीः समाः बहून्संवत्सरानुषित्वा वाससुखमनुभूय
dwelling there for many long years and experiencing the happiness of residence there
शुचीनां सदाचाराणां श्रीमतां धनिनां गेहे स योगभ्रष्टो जन्म प्राप्नोति
that person fallen from yoga takes birth in the home of pure, well-conducted, prosperous and wealthy people
अल्पकालाभ्यस्तयोगभ्रंशे गतिरियमुक्ता
this destiny was stated for one whose yoga practice was brief before falling
चिराभ्यस्तयोगभ्रंशे तु पक्षान्तरमाह अथेति
for one who practiced yoga long before falling he gives another alternative with ‘or’
योगनिष्ठानां धीमतां ज्ञानिनामेव कुले जायते
he is born in the family of wise knowers established in yoga
नतु पूर्वोक्तानामनारूढयोगानां कुले जायते
not in the family of those previously described who had not ascended yoga
एतज्जन्म स्तौति ईदृशं यज्जन्म एतद्धि लोके दुर्लभतरम् मोक्षहेतुत्वात्
he praises this birth: such a birth is exceedingly rare in the world because it causes liberation
ततः किमत आह तत्रेति सार्धेन
what then? he says in a verse and a half beginning ‘there’
तत्र द्विःप्रकारेऽपि जन्मनि पूर्वदेहे भवं पौर्वदेहिकं तमेव ब्रह्मविषयया बुद्ध्या संयोगं लभते
in either of the two births he regains the connection with the understanding concerning Brahman that belonged to his previous body
ततश्च भूयोऽधिकं संसिद्धौ मोक्षे प्रयत्नं करोति
and then he makes greater effort toward perfection, liberation
तत्र हेतुः पूर्वेति
the reason is stated with ‘previous’
तेनैव पूर्वदेहकृताभ्यासेनावशोऽपि कुतश्चिदन्तरायादनिच्छन्नपि संह्रियते
by the very practice performed in the previous body he is drawn forward even helplessly and unwillingly because of some obstacle
विषयेभ्यः परावर्त्य ब्रह्मनिष्ठः क्रियते
he is turned away from objects and made established in Brahman
तदेवं पूर्वाभ्यासवशेन प्रयत्नं कुर्वञ्शनैर्मुच्यत इतीममर्थं कैमुत्यन्यायेन स्फुटयति जिज्ञासुरिति सार्धेन
he clarifies by an a-fortiori argument that through previous practice and renewed effort he gradually becomes liberated, with ‘even the seeker’
योगस्य स्वरूपं जिज्ञासुरेव केवलं नतु प्राप्तयोगः
even one who merely wishes to know the nature of yoga, not yet one who has attained it
एवंभूतो योगे प्रविष्टमात्रोऽपि पापवशाद्योगभ्रष्टोऽपि शब्दब्रह्म वेदमतिवर्तते वेदोक्तकर्मफलान्यतिक्रामति
even one who has merely entered yoga and fallen from it through sin transcends the verbal Brahman, the Veda, surpassing the fruits of action taught by the Veda
तेभ्योऽधिकं फलं प्राप्य मुच्यत इत्यर्थः
he obtains a fruit higher than those and is liberated; this is the meaning
यदैवं मन्दप्रयत्नोऽपि योगी परां गतिं याति
if even a yogin of weak effort attains the supreme goal in this way
तदा यस्तु योगी प्रयत्नादुत्तरोत्तरमधिकं योगे यतमानो यत्नं कुर्वन्
then what need be said of the yogin who strives ever more intensely in yoga with effort
योगेनैव संशुद्धकिल्बिषो विधूतपापः
whose impurity is purified and sin removed by yoga itself
सोऽनेकेषु जन्मसूपचितेन योगेन संसिद्धः सम्यग्ज्ञानी भूत्वा ततः श्रेष्ठां गतिं याति
perfected by yoga accumulated over many births, becoming a person of right knowledge, he then attains the highest goal
यस्मादेवं तस्मात् तपस्विभ्य इति
because this is so, therefore with ‘than ascetics’
कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादितपोनिष्ठेभ्योऽपि
the yogin is superior even to those established in austerities such as Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa
ज्ञानिभ्यः शास्त्रज्ञानवद्भ्योऽपि
even to those possessing scriptural knowledge
कर्मिभ्य इष्टापूर्तादिकर्मकारिभ्योऽपि
even to performers of ritual and public works
योगी श्रेष्ठोऽभिमतः तस्मात्त्वं योगी भव
the yogin is considered superior; therefore become a yogin
योगिनामपि यमनियमादिपराणां मध्ये मद्भक्तः श्रेष्ठ इत्याह योगिनामिति
even among yogins devoted to restraints and observances, My devotee is superior; he says ‘of yogins’
मद्गतेन मय्यासक्तेनान्तरात्मना मनसा
with the inner self, the mind, gone to Me and attached to Me
यो मां परमेश्वरं वासुदेवं श्रद्धायुक्तः सन्भजते
one who worships Me, the Supreme Lord Vāsudeva, endowed with faith
स योगयुक्तेषु श्रेष्ठो मम संमतः
he is the best among those joined in yoga, in My judgment
अतो मद्भक्तो भवेति भावः
therefore become My devotee; this is the intention
